html:
The Grand Duchy of Hesse was a German state centred on Darmstadt that lasted from 1806 to 1918. It grew out of the Landgraviate of Hesse-Darmstadt, which Napoleon raised to a grand duchy when it joined his Confederation of the Rhine.

At the Congress of Vienna it gained Rhenish Hesse on the left bank of the Rhine, with the city of Mainz. From 1816 it called itself "Hesse and by Rhine" to tell itself apart from its neighbour Electoral Hesse. It was a member of the German Confederation and got a constitution in 1820.

It sided with Austria in 1866 but kept its independence, and joined the new German Empire in 1871. Its ruling family married into the great houses of Europe: Grand Duke Louis IV married Queen Victoria's daughter Alice, and their daughter Alix became the last tsarina of Russia. The monarchy ended in the revolution of 1918.
